title: Internal posts show Meta employees raising concerns that Muse could be mixing up conversations between different accounts and exposing users' private data (Katie Paul/Reuters)
summary: Katie Paul / Reuters: Internal posts show Meta employees raising concerns that Muse could be mixing up conversations between different accounts and exposing users' private data — Unbidden actions by Muse, which has been downloaded by more than 10 million people so far and is expected by Meta to generate billions …
